risks.title: Cybersecurity and Information Systems Breaches
risks.score_rationale: The risk is listed first in Item 1A, described as potentially severely affecting financial results, operations, and reputation. Strong language ('adversely affected', 'material impacts') and detailed governance framework (CISO, Audit Committee, mandatory escalation). Highly critical category in the healthcare sector. High weighting.

ai_positioning.summary: ZBH does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The information provided focuses primarily on financial aspects, acquisitions, and company operations without addressing emerging technologies such as AI.
